scope: Literal remembered-text search through reflog/history commits, unreachable commits, dropped stash working/index/untracked trees and dangling staged-only blobs.
Raw cat-file batch check/read verifies exact ID/type/size framing; bounded bytes, object/tree/commit counts, hits and UI snippets; binary/oversized/missing/incomplete results are reported.
Timeline/provenance, verified raw-content preview and separate prepare/confirm flow for create-only branch/file and CAS stash-list recovery.
No standalone reflog/lost-commit browser; PR54 remains excluded. No dependency on Working Drafts.
safety_proofs: Read-only scan compares refs/reflogs/index/object-store counts in real repository regression; no ref/index/worktree writes during search.
Explicit --no-lazy-fetch and no-replace/optional-write settings; source hooks/fsmonitor/signing/filters/diff tools disabled. Promisor and configured-helper tests include positive controls.

Initiating Profile context is captured on queued jobs and retained by shared Practice-first/fallible Git transport. Recovery remote calls remain directly owned until actual remote::exec returns; queue ownership does not depend on a timer.
One reader plus newest pending request; close/Escape/replacement/profile/park/drop invalidates generation. Recorded delayed ownership tests and actual pointer UI recovery roundtrip pass.

Source provenance and raw blob hash are rechecked on inspect/prepare/perform. Pruned sources, moved stash refs, symbolic branch destinations, existing/ignored/tracked/linked paths and raced new filenames refuse safely.

RootPin binds filesystem identity through publication: local canonical root holds a directory handle, Unix dev/ino, Windows volume/file-index and no-delete sharing. Initial root opens without following links and compares actual identity. Remote typed scripts compare captured pwd-P and GNU stat dev/ino/ctime-nanoseconds before scratch/publication; unavailable identity disables file recovery.

Final file creation is exclusive, never updates the real index, and cannot overwrite an existing inode. Remote publication is atomic ln-T from a private Git-metadata scratch file; unsupported cross-filesystem layout refuses.
Known successful update-ref results are acknowledged despite late cancellation; uncertain interruption explicitly advises inspecting refs before retry.

Windows create-only publication additionally opens and retains every rooted canonical physical ancestor in order, before each subsequent absolute lookup; drive-relative prefixes are excluded. All handles remain live through CREATE_NEW.

root_review_correction.confirmed: Initial root symlink/substitution could redirect file publication after final Git verification.

limits: Linux native gates passed. Real SSH/WSL and native Windows filesystem behavior were not exercised; typed remote scripts were executed locally and Windows handle query uses existing windows-sys APIs with a documented narrow unsafe call.

Git must support --no-lazy-fetch; unsupported Git fails closed. Binary/non-UTF-8 blobs and blobs above2MiB are skipped; raw Git blobs (including LFS pointers) are searched without filters or downloads.

Budgets:500commits,10000objects,15000file entries,64MiBblob content,300hits,50provenances/blob,120s job and30s request execution limit. Remote pool/connect wait stays owned until actual return and is not claimed to have a total timeout.
Unattached blobs have unknown original path/time and recover as new regular files. Existing/tracked/ignored targets refuse; no overwrite/automatic checkout/stash apply is offered.

Remote file recovery requires usable GNU stat/ln, a stable captured root identity and metadata/worktree on the same filesystem. Directory ctime changes can require a fresh search; unsupported identity keeps search/branch/stash available.
Local failed disk writes may leave an explicitly diagnosed incomplete new file; all preexisting files remain preserved.
Dropped-stash recognition uses standard Git stash parent topology and WIP/On/index/untracked message forms.
No CI used, dispatched, rerun, polled or awaited; user deferred CI until all implementation, final history, local gates and independent reviews are complete.

windows_corrective.scope: Retain and validate every rooted canonical physical ancestor from volume/UNC share through repository before descendant CREATE_NEW, using existing no-delete/no-reparse directory handles. No new unsafe/API/process boundary.
